newsitem.title: USA: Disney offering discounts on Disneyland tickets.
newsitem.headline: Disney offering discounts on Disneyland tickets.

text.p: Walt Disney Co., seeking to boost sales at its Disneyland theme park here, has started offering discounts to friends of season ticket holders.
The promotion, rarely done in the peak summer season, allows holders of annual passes to take up to two guests to the theme park for $26 each, a discount of $10 from the normal daily ticket price.
Disneyland spokesman John McClintock described the move as a marketing experiment rather than an indication of weak attendance at Disneyland.
While declining to comment on specific attendance figures, he said Disney expects 1997 to be "one of the best years" in the theme park's history.

Last year, an estimated 15 million people passed through tha gates at Disneyland in Los Angeles, giving a powerful boost to Disney's financial results. Attendance was helped in part by the final year of the Main Street Electric Parade. The elaborate light show was replaced with a new promotion called "Light Magic."
Disney's stock fell $2 to $75.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
